authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 5.2
authority.requirement: Header2offset at logical R2007 file-header byte offset 0x48 is relative to page-map base address 0x480.

physicalProducer.producer: ODA File Converter 27.1.0, locally authored one-LINE DXF converted to AC1021
physicalProducer.observation: LibreDWG 0.14 reads Header2offset 26304; adding 0x480 gives 27456, the last 0x400 bytes of the 28480-byte file, which exactly match the first header page.

finding: The AC1021 writer physically wrote a copy of the file-header page at the end of the file, but published zero in Header2offset and described the file as having no second header.
change: Publish the actual trailing page address relative to 0x480 and reject invalid file-size arithmetic; layout validation independently checks the offset against the assembled trailing page address.

validation.coverage: The generated physical AC1021 file is Reed-Solomon decoded. Its offset field plus 0x480 must equal the beginning of the final 0x400 bytes, and that complete page must equal the leading file-header page. AC1018 and AC1024 metadata pointer controls also pass.
validation.independentRead: LibreDWG 0.14 reads the locally generated file, reports the corrected second-header offset, and finds one LINE. The relative offset resolves to 18304 in the 19328-byte file, with identical leading and trailing 0x400-byte header pages.

independentConverter.input: Locally authored one-LINE AC1021 with prior file-header and section-profile corrections plus the current Header2offset correction
independentConverter.operation: ACAD2013 DXF, recursion disabled, audit disabled
independentConverter.result: Exit status zero with only an .err reporting Invalid input; no DXF was produced.
independentConverter.interpretation: The corrected offset is independently required and witnessed, but does not resolve the remaining ODA rejection.

limits: No claim of full-file compatibility, native semantic support, or mandatory semantics for other normally observed header fields is made.
